tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, never pure white for large areas.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Alternate band background (goals band, notice bar).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Inputs and the selected-goal panel on paper-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, primary buttons, dark panels, 2px section rules.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, table headers, 'Paid link'. 4.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink panels and the footer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px row dividers and hairlines. Never for text.

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside ink panels.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links and the Visit button. The one colour that means 'go'.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of action.

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the 'Approved' and 'Named' chips.

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Text on action-tint.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The highlighter. Under one key number per page, the compare band, the alert button. Never as text colour.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of 'Waiting for FDA' and 'Sponsored' chips.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text on warn-tint.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Inline warning text, 'Not so good' heading.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of 'Prescription needed' and 'Compounding pharmacy' chips.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text on info-tint.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of neutral chips ('Not shown', 'Not approved', 'Not sponsored') and nav hover.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed states only. Rare.

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: The real price of peptide treatment

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section H2 on landing pages. 30px on phones.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: H2 inside article pages, above a 2px ink rule.

styles.name: display-4
styles.usage: H3: guide titles, panel titles, card headings.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a page: price or score. Pair with a 20px/500 unit.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Paragraph under an H1. Colour ink-2. Max 34em.
styles.sample: What a month actually costs at each online clinic.

styles.name: intro
styles.usage: 'The short answer' paragraph at the top of article pages. Max 40ch.
styles.sample: Semaglutide is a copy of a gut hormone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fill out a health form with an online clinic.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, dates, table headers (700), breadcrumbs. Colour ink-2.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: 'Paid link' and chip text (700). Never below 13px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between form fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in ledgers, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap in button rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, section heading bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop, space under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between article and sidebar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding top and bottom; H2 top margin in articles.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space between landing sections. 56px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items. Near-sharp on purpose (28 Oct 2026): the 8–16px rounding on every card is the first thing that reads as generated.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Price board, decision card, compare band, alert band. Same 4px as controls; Master 2 uses 0, so the two sites still differ.

border.note: Borders encode hierarchy. Shadows are not used anywhere in Master 1.

tokens.name: rule-section
tokens.usage: Under a section heading, above an article H2, top of a guide tile, around the decision card.

tokens.name: rule-row
tokens.usage: Between table rows and ledger rows.

tokens.name: rule-control
tokens.usage: Inputs and outline buttons.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width, 24px side padding (16px on phones).

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Max content width from 1600px screens; type scale 1.12.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width from 2200px screens (32-inch and wider); type scale 1.25. Nothing grows past this.

tokens.name: columns
tokens.usage: Grid. Article 8 + sidebar 4. Hero 7 + 5. Under 640px everything stacks.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of primary buttons and inputs. 40px for in-table buttons.
